Repository root: /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform (API under ./api, package `codx.junior`).

!! DO NOT CALL project_map / project_locate / project_trace / project_impact !! They time out (120s each) and will consume your whole turn — this is why the previous attempt failed. Read the two files below directly with project_read_file and edit them.

PREREQUISITE (already done by a previous step, trust it): api/codx/junior/db.py now has `Message.unsent: bool = False` plus `get_unsent_message(chat_id)`, `upsert_unsent_message(chat_id, content, author)`, `delete_unsent_message(chat_id)`, and the internal chat-message reader already filters unsent messages out.

SCOPE: api/codx/junior/api/chat.py (main work) and api/codx/junior/chat/chat_prompt_builder.py (only if it reads messages through a path that bypasses the filter).

WORK:
1. In api/codx/junior/api/chat.py, next to the existing chat routes (there is `POST /chats/message`, plus chat list/get/cancel routes), add a small draft trio using the FastAPI style already used in the file (same router, same response models/dicts, same auth/dependency pattern):
   - `GET  /chats/draft?chat_id=...` → the unsent draft or 204/{"content": ""} when there is none.
   - `PUT  /chats/draft` (body: chat_id, content, optional author) → upsert and return the stored message. Must NOT create a normal message, must NOT emit a chat event to other clients, must NOT touch `last_message`.
   - `DELETE /chats/draft?chat_id=...` → delete it.
2. Sending a message must consume the draft: in the `POST /chats/message` handler, after the real message is appended, call `delete_unsent_message(chat_id)` so the draft disappears atomically with the send.
3. Verify nothing leaks: check every place in chat.py (and chat_prompt_builder.py) that iterates messages for LLM input, summaries, token counting, analytics or socket `chat-event`/`message-event` payloads. If any of them reads the raw stored list instead of the filtered helper from db.py, apply the same filter there. Document each patched site in the report.
4. No renames, no route changes to existing endpoints, no reformatting.

REPORT: routes added (method + path + handler name + line numbers), where the draft is consumed on send, and the list of sites you verified/patch for leakage.

ACCEPTANCE: the three routes exist with those exact paths; a draft can be PUT then GET then DELETE; sending a message clears the draft; grep-level review shows no prompt/token/analytics/socket path reading unfiltered messages; existing routes untouched.

### Routes added — `api/codx/junior/api/chat.py`

| Method | Path | Handler | Line |

| GET | `/chats/draft` | `api_get_chat_draft` | 915 |

| DELETE | `/chats/draft` | `api_delete_chat_draft` | 1000 |

Supporting helpers added next to the existing module helpers: `_conversation_messages(chat)` (line 64, wraps the db filter `_visible_messages`) and `_draft_response(chat_id, message)` (serializes `{chat_id, doc_id, content, author, updated_at}`; empty `content` when there is no draft, so no 204 special-case is needed client side).

* PUT contract is exactly `{chat_id, content, author?}`; `author` falls back to `request.state.user.username`. It delegates to `db.upsert_unsent_message(..., chat_manager=...)` — no normal message created, no `last_message` concept exists in the model (verified: `last_message` appears nowhere in `db.py`/`chat_manager.py`), and no `message-event` reaches other clients (guard added in `ChatManager._emit_message_event`).
* Errors: 422 without `chat_id`, 404 when the chat is unknown, 400 on invalid JSON.

### Draft consumed on send
`api_add_message` (POST `/chats/message`), lines 1085–1095: after `chat_manager.add_message(...)` the handler calls `delete_unsent_message(chat_id, chat_manager=chat_manager)` (guarded so a payload that *is* the draft, or any cleanup failure, cannot break the send).

| `chat_manager.py` | `_emit_message_event` | patched: early `return` for `message.unsent` → no socket draft broadcast |
| `chat_manager.py` | `build_markdown_document` (export) | patched: drafts excluded |
| `chat/chat_export.py`, `chat/chat_event_bridge.py` | — | verified: export content comes from `build_markdown_document`; the bridge only publishes messages it creates |

def _resolve_chat_manager(request: Request, data: Optional[dict] = None):
    """
    Resolve a ``ChatManager``/settings pair for a project for chat control.

    Prefers the session injected by the ``codx_path`` middleware; falls back to
    an explicit ``codx_path`` in the payload/query string and finally to a scan
    of the known projects by chat id, so a client can stop a turn even when it
    only knows the chat id.
    """
    session = getattr(request.state, "codx_junior_session", None)
    if session is not None:
        return session.get_chat_manager(), session.settings

    payload = data or {}
    codx_path = payload.get("codx_path") or request.query_params.get("codx_path")
    if codx_path:
        try:
            from codx.junior.chat_manager import ChatManager
            from codx.junior.settings import CODXJuniorSettings

            settings = CODXJuniorSettings.from_codx_path(codx_path)
            return ChatManager(settings=settings), settings
        except Exception as ex:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
            logger.warning("chat control: invalid codx_path '%s': %s", codx_path, ex)

    chat_id = payload.get("chat_id") or request.query_params.get("chat_id")
    if chat_id:
        try:
            from codx.junior.chat_manager import ChatManager
            from codx.junior.project.project_discover import find_all_projects

            for settings in find_all_projects().values():
                manager = ChatManager(settings=settings)
                if manager.find_by_id(chat_id) is not None:
                    return manager, settings
        except Exception as ex:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
            logger.warning(
                "chat control: could not locate chat '%s' in any project: %s",
                chat_id,
                ex,
            )
    return None, None


@router.post("/chat/cancel")
async def chat_cancel(request: Request, data: Optional[dict] = None):
    """
    Cancel / stop a chat turn by chat_id or cancellation token UUID.

    This also stops a **persisted** turn (one left behind by an application
    restart, whose in-memory ``CancellationToken`` is gone): the durable turn
    record is marked cancelled, so the recovery worker never restarts it, and
    its orphaned ``done=False`` response message is repaired so the client
    stops showing "processing".

    Expected payload (at least one key must be provided):
        {
            "chat_id":  "<chat id to cancel>",
            "token_id": "<cancellation token UUID>"
        }

    Returns:
        { "cancelled": true,  "method": "chat_id"|"token_id", "stopped_turns": n }
        { "cancelled": false, "error": "..." }
    """
    data = data or {}
    chat_id = data.get("chat_id") or request.query_params.get("chat_id")
    token_id = data.get("token_id") or request.query_params.get("token_id")
    method = None

    if not chat_id and not token_id:
        logger.warning("chat_cancel: missing 'chat_id' and 'token_id' in payload")
        return {"cancelled": False, "error": "missing chat_id or token_id"}

    cancelled = False
    if chat_id:
        logger.info("chat_cancel: attempting cancel by chat_id='%s'", chat_id)
        if CANCELLATION_REGISTRY.cancel(chat_id):
            logger.info("chat_cancel: cancelled by chat_id='%s'", chat_id)
            cancelled = True
            method = "chat_id"

    if not cancelled and token_id:
        logger.info("chat_cancel: attempting cancel by token_id='%s'", token_id)
        token = CANCELLATION_REGISTRY.get_by_token_id(token_id)
        if token is not None and not chat_id:
            chat_id = token.chat_id
        if CANCELLATION_REGISTRY.cancel_by_token_id(token_id):
            logger.info("chat_cancel: cancelled by token_id='%s'", token_id)
            cancelled = True
            method = "token_id"

    # Stop the DURABLE side even when no live token exists (app restart, lost
    # process, queued turn). This is what gives clients a "stop" for a turn
    # that is no longer running in this process.
    stopped_turns = 0
    if chat_id:
        try:
            manager, settings = _resolve_chat_manager(request, data)
            if settings is not None and getattr(settings, "codx_path", None):
                from codx.junior.chat.turn_store import (
                    get_turn_store,
                    repair_incomplete_messages,
                )

                store = get_turn_store(settings.codx_path)
                stopped_turns = store.cancel_chat(chat_id)
                chat = manager.find_by_id(chat_id)
                if chat is not None:
                    repair_incomplete_messages(
                        chat,
                        manager,
                        note="",
                        error="The turn was stopped by the user",
                        skip_turn_ids=store.live_turn_ids(),
                    )
                logger.info(
                    "chat_cancel: stopped %d durable turn(s) for chat '%s'",
                    stopped_turns,
                    chat_id,
                )
        except Exception as ex:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
            logger.exception(
                "chat_cancel: could not stop durable turns for chat '%s': %s",
                chat_id,
                ex,
            )

    if cancelled or stopped_turns:
        return {
            "cancelled": True,
            "method": method or "durable_turn",
            "stopped_turns": stopped_turns,
        }

    logger.warning(
        "chat_cancel: no in-flight token nor durable turn found for chat_id='%s' token_id='%s'",
        chat_id,
        token_id,
    )
    return {"cancelled": False, "error": "no in-flight token found"}

def chat_processing(request: Request):
    """
    Live state of the chat turns of the request project.

    This is the SAME payload broadcast over the ``codx-junior-chat-turns``
    socket event, so a client needs it only once (on open / after a reconnect)
    and never has to poll:

        { "codx_path": "...", "stale_seconds": 600.0,
          "turns": [ { "turn_id", "chat_id", "status", "attempts",
                       "max_attempts", "started_at", "updated_at",
                       "heartbeat_at", "heartbeat_age", "stale_seconds",
                       "stalled", "alive", "error", "pid", "host" } ] }

    ``stalled`` is True when the turn made no progress for ``stale_seconds``:
    the message rendered as "processing" is DEAD (hung AI request, a tool
    blocked forever, a deadlocked thread) and the server stops and restarts it.
    ``alive`` is False when no live process owns the turn any more.

    manager, settings = _resolve_chat_manager(request)
    if settings is None or not getattr(settings, "codx_path", None):
        return {"turns": [], "error": "codx_path is required"}

    except Exception as ex:

    """
    Re-run the last turn of a chat whose execution died.

    This backs the client "re-run" action: the message that stayed on
    "processing" (or failed after the recovery attempts) is repaired into a

    A turn that is really running is never duplicated: only a dead turn
    (stalled or orphaned) can be re-run.

        { "chat_id": "<chat id>" }

        { "started": true,  "chat_id": ..., "repaired_messages": n }

        return {"started": False, "error": "missing chat_id"}

    if settings is None or not getattr(settings, "codx_path", None):
        return {"started": False, "error": "codx_path is required"}

            get_turn_store,
            repair_incomplete_messages,

                continue
            alive = store.is_owned(record.turn_id)
            if not alive:
                # A free lock is an orphan; a held one is a live runner.
                if store.claim(record):
                    store.release(record.turn_id)
                else:
                    alive = True
            if alive:
                return {
                    "started": False,
                    "reason": "already_running",
                    "turn_id": record.turn_id,

        if chat is None:

        # every orphaned "processing" message into a terminal one.

        repaired = repair_incomplete_messages(

            note="",

            skip_turn_ids=store.live_turn_ids(),
        )

        session = getattr(request.state, "codx_junior_session", None)
        if session is None:
            from codx.junior.engine import CODXJuniorSession

            session = CODXJuniorSession(
                settings=settings,
                codx_path=settings.codx_path,
                user=getattr(request.state, "user", None),
            )

        owner_project_id = getattr(chat, "owner_project_id", None)

        async def _run_turn() -> None:
            """Execute the re-run without blocking the HTTP response."""
            try:
                await session.chat_with_project(
                    chat_id=chat_id,
                    owner_project_id=owner_project_id,
                )
            except Exception as ex:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
                logger.exception(
                    "chat_turn_rerun: chat '%s' failed to re-run: %s", chat_id, ex
                )
            finally:
                publish_turn_states(settings.codx_path, force=True)

        asyncio.create_task(_run_turn())
        publish_turn_states(settings.codx_path, force=True)
        logger.info(
            "chat_turn_rerun: chat '%s' re-run started (repaired %d message(s))",
            chat_id,
            repaired,
        )
        return {
            "started": True,
            "chat_id": chat_id,
            "repaired_messages": repaired,
        }
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.exception("chat_turn_rerun: could not re-run chat '%s': %s", chat_id, ex)
        return {"started": False, "error": str(ex)}


@router.get("/chats/recent")
def api_get_recent_chats(request: Request):
    """
    Get recent chats with optional filtering and pagination.

    Query parameters:
        - user_id: Filter chats by user who created or participated (optional)
        - board: Filter chats by board name (optional)
        - column: Filter chats by column name (optional)
        - chat_type: Filter chats by type 'task' or 'chat' (optional)
        - page: Page number (1-indexed, default: 1)
        - page_size: Results per page (default: 10, max: 100)

    Returns:
        {
            "chats": [Chat objects],
            "total": total count,
            "page": current page,
            "page_size": page size,
            "total_pages": calculated total pages,
            "has_next": boolean,
            "has_prev": boolean
        }
    """
    try:
        codx_junior_session = request.state.codx_junior_session
        chat_manager = codx_junior_session.get_chat_manager()

        user_id = request.query_params.get("user_id")
        board = request.query_params.get("board")
        column = request.query_params.get("column")
        chat_type = request.query_params.get("chat_type")

        try:
            page = max(1, int(request.query_params.get("page", 1)))
            page_size = max(1, min(100, int(request.query_params.get("page_size", 10))))
        except (TypeError, ValueError) as ex:
            logger.error("api_get_recent_chats: invalid pagination params: %s", ex)
            return {
                "error": "Invalid page or page_size parameters",
                "chats": [],
                "total": 0,
                "page": 1,
                "page_size": 10,
                "total_pages": 0,
                "has_next": False,
                "has_prev": False,
            }

        results = chat_manager.get_recent_chats(
            user_id=user_id,
            board=board,
            column=column,
            chat_type=chat_type,
            page=page,
            page_size=page_size,
        )

        logger.info(
            "api_get_recent_chats: user_id=%s board=%s column=%s chat_type=%s "
            "returned %d chats, page %d of %d",
            user_id or "all",
            board or "all",
            column or "all",
            chat_type or "all",
            results["total"],
            results["page"],
            results["total_pages"],
        )
        return results

    except Exception as ex:
        logger.error("api_get_recent_chats: unexpected error: %s", ex)
        return {
            "error": f"Failed to retrieve recent chats: {str(ex)}",
            "chats": [],
            "total": 0,
            "page": 1,
            "page_size": 10,
            "total_pages": 0,
            "has_next": False,
            "has_prev": False,
        }


@router.get("/chats/logs")
def api_get_chat_logs(request: Request):
    """
    Get complete AI log summary for a chat, including forensic audit trail.

    This endpoint aggregates all AI interactions (LLM requests, tool calls, token usage)
    for a single chat into a comprehensive summary with detailed metrics and complete
    forensic audit trail for debugging and compliance.

    ## Query Parameters
    - **chat_id** (required): UUID of the chat to retrieve logs for

    ## Response Structure: ChatLogSummary

    ### Summary Metrics
    - **chat_id**: The chat identifier used in query
    - **session_id**: Session identifier (if available from chat metadata)
    - **total_log_records**: Total count of all logged records (requests + responses + errors)
    - **total_requests**: Count of LLM completion requests sent
    - **total_responses**: Count of LLM completion responses received
    - **total_duration_seconds**: Aggregate wall-clock time for all AI calls
    - **average_request_duration_seconds**: Mean duration per LLM request

    ### Status Distribution
    - **status_distribution.success**: Count of successful requests/responses
    - **status_distribution.error**: Count of failed or errored requests
    - **status_distribution.cancelled**: Count of user-cancelled requests

    ### Token Usage (Estimated)
    - **token_stats.total_estimated_input_tokens**: Sum of prompt tokens across all requests
    - **token_stats.total_estimated_output_tokens**: Sum of completion tokens across all responses
    - **token_stats.total_estimated_tokens**: Grand total of input + output tokens

    ### Model Usage Breakdown
    - **model_usage**: Array of model usage statistics, each with:
      - **model**: Model name (e.g., "gpt-4o", "claude-3")
      - **provider**: Provider identifier (e.g., "openai", "anthropic")
      - **request_count**: Number of requests using this model/provider
      - **total_duration_seconds**: Cumulative duration for this model/provider

    ### Timestamp Range
    - **first_timestamp**: ISO-8601 timestamp of earliest log record
    - **last_timestamp**: ISO-8601 timestamp of latest log record

    ### Error Tracking
    - **has_errors**: Boolean indicating presence of error or cancelled records
    - **error_details**: Array of error messages (first 5 only, for readability)

    ### Fallback Status
    - **fallback_used**: Boolean indicating whether fallback query strategy was used
    - **fallback_reason**: Explanation if fallback was necessary (e.g., "no session_id available")

    ### Forensic Audit Trail (raw_log_records)
    **Complete forensic record of all AI interactions, suitable for audit compliance,
    debugging, and conversation replay.**

    - **raw_log_records**: Array of forensic records, sorted chronologically. Each record
      is either a ForensicArchivedMessageRecord or ForensicToolCallRecord:

    #### ForensicArchivedMessageRecord
    Represents a complete LLM request-response cycle with all model configuration:
    - **message_id**: Unique message identifier
    - **request_id**: Links to token usage event for cross-reference
    - **timestamp**: Unix timestamp of when recorded
    - **iso_date**: ISO date string (for partitioning)
    - **request_messages**: Complete OpenAI-format message array sent to model
      (includes all prior messages in conversation + system prompt)
    - **system_prompt**: The exact system message sent to the model
    - **temperature**: LLM temperature parameter (for reproducibility)
    - **max_tokens**: Maximum tokens limit enforced
    - **tools**: Complete JSON schema definitions of all tools available to model
    - **response_content**: Full text content of LLM response
    - **input_tokens**: Number of input tokens consumed
    - **output_tokens**: Number of output tokens generated
    - **duration_seconds**: Wall-clock duration of request
    - **error**: Error message if request failed (null if successful)
    - **cancelled**: Boolean indicating if request was user-cancelled
    - **model**: Model name used (e.g., "gpt-4o")
    - **provider**: Provider identifier (e.g., "openai")
    - **chat_id**: Parent chat identifier
    - **username**: User who triggered the request
    - **project_name**: Project context
    - **project_id**: Project identifier

    #### ForensicToolCallRecord
    Represents a complete tool execution with all invocation details:
    - **message_id**: Unique message identifier
    - **tool_call_id**: Tool call ID from LLM (uniquely identifies this tool invocation)
    - **timestamp**: Unix timestamp of when recorded
    - **iso_date**: ISO date string (for partitioning)
    - **tool_name**: Name of the tool function invoked
    - **tool_definition**: Complete JSON schema definition of the tool as sent to model
    - **request_args**: Parsed arguments sent to tool (dict with parameter values)
    - **result**: Raw result returned by tool (may be string, dict, list, or error message)
    - **result_sent_to_model**: Normalized result sent back to LLM (always string)
    - **duration_seconds**: Execution time in seconds
    - **success**: Boolean indicating if tool executed without exception
    - **error_message**: Error details if execution failed (null if successful)
    - **cached**: Boolean indicating if result was from in-conversation cache
    - **chat_id**: Parent chat identifier
    - **username**: User who triggered the tool
    - **project_name**: Project context
    - **project_id**: Project identifier

    ## Example Response (Simplified)

    ## Use Cases

    ### Debugging
    Use raw_log_records to trace exact model inputs/outputs, tool definitions, and parameters.
    Each record contains complete payload for reproducing behavior.

    ### Compliance & Audit
    Complete forensic trail with timestamps, user attribution, and all model settings
    enables compliance with data governance and audit requirements.

    ### Performance Analysis
    Token counts and duration metrics per request/tool enable identification of
    bottlenecks and cost optimization opportunities.

    ### Conversation Replay
    Chronologically ordered records with complete system prompts, messages, and
    model parameters allow exact conversation replay for testing or debugging.

    ### Cost Attribution
    Token counts × provider pricing yields exact cost per conversation for
    billing and budget tracking.

    ## Error Responses

    **404 - Chat Not Found**
    ```json
    {
      "error": "Chat not found: <chat_id>",
      "chat_id": "<requested chat_id>"
    }
    ```

    **500 - Query or Processing Error**
    ```json
    {
      "error": "Failed to retrieve chat logs: <error details>"
    }
    ```

    ## HTTP Status Codes
    - **200**: Successfully retrieved logs
    - **404**: Chat not found
    - **500**: Unexpected error during query or aggregation
    """
    try:
        codx_junior_session = request.state.codx_junior_session

            "api_get_chat_logs: completed for chat_id='%s' "

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Unsent draft (composer state)
#
# While the user types, the composer text is persisted as the chat's single
# ``unsent`` message so it survives a reload. That message is NOT part of the
# conversation: it is filtered out of every reader (chat list/detail, LLM
# prompt, socket message events, analytics, exports) and only the composer that
# owns it reads, updates or deletes it through the three routes below.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


@router.get("/chats/draft")
def api_get_chat_draft(request: Request):
    """
    Return the unsent draft of a chat (the text its composer is still typing).

    Query parameters:
        - chat_id: <chat UUID> (required)

    Returns:
        { "chat_id", "doc_id", "content", "author", "updated_at" }

    ``content`` is an empty string when the chat has no draft, so the client
    needs no special case. The draft never appears in the chat returned by
    ``GET /chats``: this route is its only reader.
    """
    from codx.junior.db import get_unsent_message

    chat_id = request.query_params.get("chat_id")
    if not chat_id:
        logger.warning("api_get_chat_draft: missing chat_id")
        return {"error": "missing chat_id parameter", "content": ""}

    try:
        chat_manager = request.state.codx_junior_session.get_chat_manager()
        message = get_unsent_message(chat_id, chat_manager=chat_manager)
        return _draft_response(chat_id, message)
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.error("api_get_chat_draft: unexpected error: %s", ex)
        return {"error": f"Failed to load draft: {str(ex)}", "content": ""}


@router.put("/chats/draft")
async def api_save_chat_draft(request: Request):
    """
    Create or update the unsent draft of a chat (debounced while typing).

    Expected JSON payload:
        {
            "chat_id": "<chat UUID>",
            "content": "...",
            "author":  "<optional username>"
        }

    The draft is persisted as the chat's single ``unsent`` message, so it never
    becomes a conversation message: no ``message-event`` is broadcast to other
    clients, no normal message is created and the model never receives it.

    Returns:
        The stored draft: { "chat_id", "doc_id", "content", "author",
        "updated_at" } (HTTP 422 without ``chat_id``, 404 when the chat is
        unknown).
    """
    from codx.junior.db import upsert_unsent_message

    try:
        data = await request.json()
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.error("api_save_chat_draft: invalid payload: %s", ex)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Invalid JSON payload: {ex}")

    chat_id = data.get("chat_id")
    if not chat_id:
        logger.error("api_save_chat_draft: missing chat_id")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="'chat_id' is required")

    user = getattr(request.state, "user", None)
    author = data.get("author") or getattr(user, "username", None)

    try:
        chat_manager = request.state.codx_junior_session.get_chat_manager()
        message = upsert_unsent_message(
            chat_id=chat_id,
            content=data.get("content") or "",
            author=author,
            chat_manager=chat_manager,
        )
        return _draft_response(chat_id, message)
    except ValueError as ex:
        logger.warning("api_save_chat_draft: %s", ex)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(ex))
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.error("api_save_chat_draft: unexpected error: %s", ex)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to save draft: {ex}")


@router.delete("/chats/draft")
def api_delete_chat_draft(request: Request):
    """
    Discard the unsent draft of a chat.

    Query parameters:
        - chat_id: <chat UUID> (required)

    Called by the composer after a successful send (the draft is consumed there
    as well, see ``api_add_message``) and when the user clears the input.
    Deleting a chat without a draft is not an error.

    Returns:
        { "deleted": true|false }
    """
    from codx.junior.db import delete_unsent_message

    chat_id = request.query_params.get("chat_id")
    if not chat_id:
        logger.warning("api_delete_chat_draft: missing chat_id")
        return {"error": "missing chat_id parameter", "deleted": False}

    try:
        chat_manager = request.state.codx_junior_session.get_chat_manager()
        deleted = delete_unsent_message(chat_id, chat_manager=chat_manager)
        logger.info(
            "api_delete_chat_draft: chat='%s' deleted=%s", chat_id, deleted
        )
        return {"deleted": bool(deleted)}
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.error("api_delete_chat_draft: unexpected error: %s", ex)
        return {"error": f"Failed to delete draft: {str(ex)}", "deleted": False}


@router.post("/chats/message")
async def api_add_message(request: Request):
    """
    Add a single message to a chat (merge-safe, idempotent).

    Expected JSON payload:
        {
            "chat_id": "<chat UUID>",
            "message": {
                "content": "...",
                "role": "user|assistant|system",
                "doc_id": "<optional UUID>",
                ...other Message fields
            }
        }

    Returns:
        The updated Chat object with merged messages.
    """
    from codx.junior.db import Message
    
    try:
        data = await request.json()
        codx_junior_session = request.state.codx_junior_session
        chat_manager = codx_junior_session.get_chat_manager()
        
        chat_id = data.get("chat_id")
        message_data = data.get("message")
        
        if not chat_id or not message_data:
            logger.error("api_add_message: missing chat_id or message")
            return {"error": "missing chat_id or message"}
        
        chat = chat_manager.find_by_id(chat_id=chat_id)
        if not chat:
            logger.error("api_add_message: chat not found: %s", chat_id)
            return {"error": f"chat '{chat_id}' not found"}
        if _is_harness_chat(chat):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=409,
                detail=(
                    "This task is executed by an external harness: its "
                    f"transcript is read-only. Use the task harness prompt "
                    f"endpoint for session {_harness_task_id(chat)}."
                ),
            )

        message = Message(**message_data)
        updated_chat = chat_manager.add_message(chat=chat, message=message)

        # Sending CONSUMES the composer draft (unless the payload IS the draft):
        # the unsent message is discarded together with the real one, so no
        # stale text is left behind for the next prompt or another client.
        if not getattr(message, "unsent", False):
            try:
                from codx.junior.db import delete_unsent_message

                delete_unsent_message(chat_id, chat_manager=chat_manager)
            except Exception as draft_ex:  # pragma: no cover - best effort
                logger.warning(
                    "api_add_message: could not clear the draft of chat '%s': %s",
                    chat_id,
                    draft_ex,
                )

        return updated_chat
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.error("api_add_message: unexpected error: %s", ex)
        return {"error": f"Failed to add message: {str(ex)}"}

    Expected JSON payload:
        {
            "chat_id": "<chat UUID>",
            "message": {
                "doc_id": "<message UUID>",
                "content": "...",
                "role": "user|assistant|system",

@router.post("/chats/metadata")

@router.get("/chats")
def api_list_chats(request: Request):
    """
    List chats with optional filtering and export.

    Query parameters:
        - file_path: Load a specific chat by file path.
        - id: Load a specific chat by ID.
        - export_format: Export format (markdown, docx, pdf, excel, etc.).
        - date_from: ISO-format start date (inclusive) for filtering chats.
        - date_to: ISO-format end date (inclusive) for filtering chats.
        - from_date: (legacy) alias of ``date_from``.

    When neither ``date_from`` nor ``date_to`` is provided, the list defaults
    to chats updated within the last ``DEFAULT_CHAT_HISTORY_DAYS`` (30) days.

    Returns:
        Single Chat object if id or file_path is provided.
        Export response if export_format is provided.
        List of Chat objects otherwise.
    """
    try:
        codx_junior_session = request.state.codx_junior_session
        chat_manager = codx_junior_session.get_chat_manager()
        file_path = request.query_params.get("file_path")
        chat_id = request.query_params.get("id")
        export_format = request.query_params.get("export_format")
        # date_from is the new parameter name; from_date is kept for
        # backward compatibility with existing clients.
        date_from = request.query_params.get("date_from") or request.query_params.get("from_date")
        date_to = request.query_params.get("date_to")

        if export_format:
            export = chat_manager.export_chat(chat_id=chat_id, export_format=export_format)
            return Response(
                content=export.content,
                media_type=export.content_type,
                headers={"Content-Disposition": f"attachment; filename={export.file_name}"}
            )

        if chat_id:
            chat = chat_manager.find_by_id(chat_id=chat_id)
            if not chat:
                logger.error('Chat not found. chat_id: %s, project: %s', chat_id, codx_junior_session.settings.project_name)
            elif _is_dsh_chat(chat):
                # The DSH Session log remains the only copy of the
                # conversation. Hydration is an in-memory read: nothing is
                # written back to the task JSON.
                try:
                    from codx.junior.integrations.dsh import DshConfig, DshSync
                    from codx.junior.integrations.dsh_agent import (
                        DshAgentClient,
                        get_dsh_agent_registry,
                    )
                    config = DshConfig.from_settings(codx_junior_session.settings)
                    registry = get_dsh_agent_registry()
                    chat_instance_id = getattr(chat, "external_instance_id", None)
                    instance = (
                        registry.get(chat_instance_id)
                        if chat_instance_id
                        else registry.default_instance(
                            getattr(codx_junior_session.settings, "project_id", None),
                            config.default_instance_id,
                        )
                    )
                    if instance is not None:
                        client = DshAgentClient(
                            registry,
                            instance.id,
                            timeout=max(config.timeout, 20),
                        )
                        DshSync(
                            codx_junior_session.settings,
                            config=config,
                            client=client,
                            instance_id=instance.id,
                        ).for_chat_manager(chat_manager).hydrate_chat(chat)
                except Exception as ex:
                    logger.warning("api_list_chats: cannot hydrate DSH chat %s: %s", chat_id, ex)
            # The unsent draft never reaches other clients: it is filtered out
            # here and read only through GET /chats/draft by its composer.
            chat.messages = _conversation_messages(chat)
            return chat

        if file_path:
            chat = chat_manager.load_chat_from_path(chat_file=file_path)
            if not chat:
                logger.error('Chat not found. file_path: %s, project: %s', file_path, codx_junior_session.settings.project_name)
            if chat is not None:
                chat.messages = _conversation_messages(chat)
            return chat

        # Default to the last 30 days when the caller does not inform a range
        if not date_from and not date_to:
            now = datetime.now()
            date_from = (now - timedelta(days=DEFAULT_CHAT_HISTORY_DAYS)).isoformat()
            date_to = now.isoformat()
            logger.info(
                "api_list_chats: no date range provided, defaulting to last "
                "%d days (date_from=%s, date_to=%s)",
                DEFAULT_CHAT_HISTORY_DAYS,
                date_from,
                date_to,
            )

        logger.info(
            "api_list_chats: listing chats for project=%s date_from=%s date_to=%s",
            codx_junior_session.settings.project_name,
            date_from or "all",
            date_to or "open",
        )
        return chat_manager.list_chats(from_date=date_from, to_date=date_to)
    except ValueError as ex:
        logger.error("api_list_chats: invalid date format: %s", ex)
        return {"error": "Invalid date format (use ISO format: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS)"}
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.error("api_list_chats: unexpected error: %s", ex)
        return {"error": f"Failed to list chats: {str(ex)}"}


@router.post("/chats/search")
async def api_search_chats(request: Request):
    """
    Search chats with full-text search, field-level filtering, user filtering,
    project filtering, and pagination.

    Expected JSON payload:
        {
            "query": "<search query string>",
            "user_id": "<optional user ID to filter by>",
            "project_ids": [<optional project ID list>],
            "from_date": "<ISO-format date, optional>",
            "to_date": "<ISO-format date, optional>",
            "page": 1,
            "page_size": 20,
            "filters": { ... }
        }

    When no query is provided and project_ids is specified, returns latest
    chats from those projects (sorted by recency).

    Returns:
        Paginated search results with relevance scores.
    """
    try:
        data = await request.json()
        codx_junior_session = request.state.codx_junior_session
        chat_manager = codx_junior_session.get_chat_manager()

        query = data.get("query", "")
        user_id = data.get("user_id")
        project_ids = data.get("project_ids")
        from_date = data.get("from_date")
        to_date = data.get("to_date")
        page = data.get("page", 1)
        page_size = data.get("page_size", 20)
        filters_data = data.get("filters")

        # Validate inputs
        try:
            page = max(1, int(page))
            page_size = max(1, min(100, int(page_size)))
        except (TypeError, ValueError) as ex:
            logger.error("api_search_chats: invalid pagination params: %s", ex)
            return {
                "error": "Invalid page or page_size parameters",
                "results": [],
                "total": 0,
                "page": 1,
                "page_size": page_size,
                "total_pages": 0,
                "has_next": False,
                "has_prev": False,
            }

        # Get user from session for permission-based project loading
        user = getattr(request.state, 'user', None)

        # Delegate search to chat_manager with project_ids and user context
        results = chat_manager.search_chats(
            query=query,
            user_id=user_id,
            from_date=from_date,
            to_date=to_date,
            project_ids=project_ids,
            page=page,
            page_size=page_size,
            user=user,
        )

        logger.info(
            "api_search_chats: query='%s' user_id=%s project_ids=%s returned %d results, page %d of %d",
            query or "(no query)",
            user_id or "all",
            project_ids or "all",
            results.get("total", 0),
            results.get("page", 1),
            results.get("total_pages", 0),
        )
        return results

    except ValueError as ex:
        logger.error("api_search_chats: invalid date format: %s", ex)
        return {
            "error": "Invalid date format (use ISO format: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS)",
            "results": [],
            "total": 0,
            "page": 1,
            "page_size": 20,
            "total_pages": 0,
            "has_next": False,
            "has_prev": False,
        }
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.error("api_search_chats: unexpected error: %s", ex)
        return {
            "error": f"Search failed: {str(ex)}",
            "results": [],
            "total": 0,
            "page": 1,
            "page_size": 20,
            "total_pages": 0,
            "has_next": False,
            "has_prev": False,
        }

@router.post("/chats/tasks")
async def api_create_task(request: Request, user: CodxUser = Depends(get_authenticated_user)):
    """
    Create a task (kanban chat) with ALL of its information.

    This is the API counterpart of the ``create_task`` / ``project_manager``
    tools: both delegate to :class:`codx.junior.task_manager.TaskManager`, so the
    created task is identical no matter the channel.

    Expected JSON payload::

        {
            "name":        "Fix login timeout",              # required
            "description": "## Context\\n...\\n## Done\\n...",  # required
            "content":     "initial user instruction",       # optional (= description)
            "board":       "kanban",
            "column":      "tasks",
            "sprints":     ["Sprint 12"],
            "status":      "todo",
            "priority":    "high",
            "due_date":    "2024-05-31",
            "progress":    0,
            "assignees":   ["user@example.com"],
            "profiles":    ["backend"],
            "files":       ["api/auth/login.py"],
            "tags":        ["auth", "bug"],
            "parent_id":   "<parent chat id>"
        }

    Nothing is inherited from another chat: ``profiles``, ``files``, ``tags``
    and the content come only from the payload.

    Returns:
        The created Chat, as a dict (HTTP 422 when required data is missing).

    Example:
        >>> POST /api/chats/tasks?codx_path=/projects/api
        {"name": "Fix login timeout", "description": "## Context ..."}
        # -> {"id": "…", "name": "Fix login timeout", "mode": "task", ...}
    """
    try:
        data = await request.json()
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.error("api_create_task: invalid payload: %s", ex)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Invalid JSON payload: {ex}")

    name = str(data.get("name") or "").strip()
    description = str(data.get("description") or "").strip()
    if not name or not description:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=(
                "'name' and 'description' are required: a task is created with "
                "all its information (there is no AI sub-task generation anymore)."
            ),
        )

    try:
        codx_junior_session = request.state.codx_junior_session
        task = codx_junior_session.get_task_manager().create_task(
            name=name,
            description=description,
            content=data.get("content"),
            board=data.get("board"),
            column=data.get("column"),
            sprints=data.get("sprints"),
            status=data.get("status"),
            priority=data.get("priority"),
            due_date=data.get("due_date"),
            progress=data.get("progress"),
            assignees=data.get("assignees"),
            profiles=data.get("profiles"),
            files=data.get("files"),
            tags=data.get("tags"),
            parent_id=data.get("parent_id"),
            user=user.username if user else None,
        )
        logger.info(
            "api_create_task: task '%s' created (board=%s column=%s)",
            task.id, task.board, task.column,
        )
        return task
    except ValueError as ex:
        logger.warning("api_create_task: invalid task: %s", ex)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(ex))
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.error("api_create_task: unexpected error: %s", ex)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to create task: {ex}")


@router.put("/chats")
async def api_save_chat(request: Request):
    """
    Save chat. Delegates to chat_manager.
    """
    from codx.junior.db import Chat
    
    try:
        data = await request.json()
        chat = Chat(**data)
        codx_junior_session = request.state.codx_junior_session
        chat_manager = codx_junior_session.get_chat_manager()
        
        chat_only = request.query_params.get("chat_only") == "1"
        existing = chat_manager.find_by_id(chat.id) if chat.id else None
        if _is_harness_chat(existing):
            # The mirror must never persist a conversation copy: keep the
            # stored (empty) message list and only accept metadata edits.
            chat.messages = existing.messages
            for field in (
                "harness", "harness_instance_id", "harness_task_id",
                "harness_parent_task_id", "harness_mode", "harness_status",
                "harness_model", "harness_usage", "harness_cost",
                "harness_metadata", "external_source", "external_id",
                "external_parent_id", "external_instance_id", "external_status",
                "external_url", "external_updated_at",
            ):
                if not getattr(chat, field, None):
                    setattr(chat, field, getattr(existing, field, None))
            chat_only = True
        saved_chat = chat_manager.save_chat(chat=chat, chat_only=chat_only)
        
        return saved_chat
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.error("api_save_chat: unexpected error: %s", ex)
        return {"error": f"Failed to save chat: {str(ex)}"}

@router.put("/chats/mark-seen/{chat_id}/{message_id}")
async def api_mark_message_as_seen(
    request: Request, 
    chat_id: str, 
    message_id: str,
    user: CodxUser = Depends(get_authenticated_user)):
    """
    Mark a message as seen by the current user.
    
    Called when a message receives focus and the user is not already in read_by list.
    
    Path parameters:
        - chat_id: UUID of the chat
        - message_id: UUID of the message
    
    Returns:
        { "success": true, "read_by": [...usernames] }
        { "error": "...", "success": false }
    """
    try:
        codx_junior_session = request.state.codx_junior_session
        chat_manager = codx_junior_session.get_chat_manager()
        
        if not user or not user.username:
            logger.error("api_mark_message_as_seen: no user in request")
            return {"error": "user not found", "success": False}
        
        username = user.username
        
        chat = chat_manager.find_by_id(chat_id=chat_id)
        if not chat:
            logger.error("api_mark_message_as_seen: chat not found: %s", chat_id)
            return {"error": f"chat '{chat_id}' not found", "success": False}
        
        message = next((m for m in chat.messages if m.doc_id == message_id), None)
        if not message:
            logger.error("api_mark_message_as_seen: message not found: %s in chat %s", message_id, chat_id)
            return {"error": f"message '{message_id}' not found", "success": False}
        
        read_by = chat_manager.mark_message_as_seen(
            chat=chat,
            message=message,
            username=username
        )
        
        logger.info(
            "api_mark_message_as_seen: chat='%s' message='%s' user='%s' read_by=%s",
            chat_id,
            message_id,
            username,
            read_by,
        )
        return {"success": True, "read_by": read_by}
    
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.error("api_mark_message_as_seen: unexpected error: %s", ex)
        return {"error": f"Failed to mark message as seen: {str(ex)}", "success": False}

    """

```py api/codx/junior/chat/chat_prompt_builder.py
"""
Prompt and message construction for chat interactions.

Extracted from ``ChatEngine`` to keep prompt-building logic (history
rendering, refine prompts, current-request wrapping, and response file
extraction) in one place and reduce the size of the engine module.

The key idea is to demote prior conversation turns to inert *context* so the
model does not re-execute instructions that were already processed:

* Prior turns are wrapped in a ``<conversation_history>`` block and their
  assistant messages are labelled ``<assistant_done>``.
* The live instruction is isolated in a ``<current_request>`` block.

Tool memory
-----------
Text-only history loses the work done by the tools of previous turns, which
made the agent re-run the same reads/searches on every user request. Prior
tool events are therefore distilled into a ``<session_memory>`` block appended
to the history (see :mod:`codx.junior.chat.chat_tool_memory`): deduplicated
tool results, already inspected files and stale markers. The model is told to
reuse it instead of calling the same tool again.

Multimodal content
------------------
Messages with attachments are converted into LangChain messages whose
``content`` is a LIST of parts (``{"type": "text"}`` plus one
``{"type": "image_url"}`` per image). Prompt assembly must therefore only
ever rewrite the TEXT part: stringifying the list would replace the images
with their Python representation and make them invisible to the model.
See :meth:`ChatPromptBuilder._get_text_content` /
:meth:`ChatPromptBuilder._set_text_content`.

Conversation attachments
------------------------
``Message.attachments`` must ALWAYS be visible to the model — not only on the
message that happens to be the current request. Because the history block is
rendered as plain text, images carried by prior turns would otherwise be lost.

:meth:`ChatPromptBuilder.collect_attachments` gathers the attachments of EVERY
visible message (parent chats first, then the current chat) and
:meth:`ChatPromptBuilder.build_ai_prompt_messages` appends them to the single
``<current_request>`` message:

* ``image/*`` attachments become ``{"type": "image_url"}`` parts,
* every other type (audio notes, documents) is listed in a ``## Attachments``
  text block ONLY, so the model still knows it exists without the request
  carrying an invalid ``image_url`` part.

Attachment payload normalization
--------------------------------
An ``image_url`` part is only useful when the provider can DECODE it. When it
cannot, models do not fail the request: they replace the image with an
``[Unsupported Image]`` placeholder, which looks like "the AI cannot see my
screenshots". :meth:`ChatPromptBuilder._prepare_attachment` therefore
normalizes every payload before it is sent:

* a ``base64_data`` value that already holds a full ``data:`` URI is not
  prefixed a second time (``data:image/png;base64,data:image/png;base64,...``
  is not decodable),
* whitespace/newlines inside the base64 payload are stripped,
* the media type is resolved from ``file_type`` → data-URI header → file
  extension, so ``application/octet-stream`` / ``image/*`` are never sent,
* the REAL format is sniffed from the payload's magic bytes and wins over
  ``file_type``: a phone gallery sends ``image/heic`` (accepted and stored) and
  some shares carry no type at all,
* only formats vision APIs accept (PNG/JPEG/WEBP/GIF) travel verbatim —
  BMP/TIFF/HEIC/AVIF are decoded with Pillow and re-encoded as PNG/JPEG (best
  effort, cached per payload); only images that cannot be decoded at all (SVG,
  Pillow missing) are listed in the text block instead,
* oversized screenshots are downscaled/re-encoded (Pillow, best effort,
  cached per payload).

The resulting status of every attachment (mime, size, sent / not sent and
why) is written into the ``## Attachments`` text block.

def sniff_image_format(payload: str) -> str:
    """
    Detect the real image format of a base64 payload from its magic bytes.

    ``ChatAttachment.file_type`` is whatever the client reported, and mobile
    clients often report something else than the bytes they send: an iPhone
    gallery screenshot is declared ``image/heic``, a picture shared from another
    app can arrive with no type at all (``application/octet-stream``). The
    payload is the only trustworthy source, so the format used for the model
    request is detected here instead of being taken from the metadata.

    :param payload: Bare base64 payload (already whitespace-free).
    :return: Format name (``png``, ``jpeg``, ``gif``, ``webp``, ``bmp``,
             ``tiff``, ``heif``) or an empty string when it is not an image.
    """
    if not payload:
        return ""
    head_b64 = payload[:96]
    try:
        head = base64.b64decode(head_b64 + "=" * (-len(head_b64) % 4))
    except (binascii.Error, ValueError):
        return ""

    if head.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"):
        return "png"
    if head.startswith(b"\xff\xd8\xff"):
        return "jpeg"
    if head.startswith(b"GIF8"):
        return "gif"
    if head[:4] == b"RIFF" and head[8:12] == b"WEBP":
        return "webp"
    if head.startswith(b"BM"):
        return "bmp"
    if head.startswith((b"II*\x00", b"MM\x00*")):
        return "tiff"
    # ISO base media file: HEIC/HEIF (iPhone) and AVIF share the ``ftyp`` box.
    if head[4:8] == b"ftyp" and head[8:12] in (
        b"heic", b"heix", b"hevc", b"heim", b"heis", b"mif1", b"msf1",
        b"avif", b"avis",
    ):
        return "heif"
    return ""
